newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bavaria cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bavaria cut to hold.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 15 Reuter - ING Barings said it had downgraded Colombian brewing giant Bavaria from buy to hold following the recent rally in its local share price.

"The change is based on limited upside in the company stock, not on any deterioration in the underlying company fundamentals," Alejandra Torres, head of Colombian Equity Research at ING Barings, said in a statement.
The statement noted that Bavaria, the country's hottest stock and flagship of the Julio Mario Santo Domingo conglomerate, had outperformed the market by 53 percent in dollar terms so far this year.
Bavaria is currently trading at $7.60 per share. Torres said she had set her year-end target price for the stock at $8.30, allowing for a 9.0 percent additional upside.

Her statement said the recent rally in Bavaria stock was partly due to management plans to separate its beverage operations from its investment portfolio and split the current share into two, reflecting each portion of the company's business.
